news.headline: Asian chip stocks slide ahead of Nvidia earnings
news.summary: Investing.com-- Asian semiconductor stocks fell on Monday as investors trimmed exposure to artificial intelligence-related shares ahead of Nvidia's quarterly earnings, with uncertainty surrounding the chipmaker's leadership transition adding to concerns over the sustainability of the AI investment boom.

news.headline: Asian shares are mixed as investors assess impact of Nvidia's fallout on global AI development
news.summary: HONG KONG (AP) — Asian shares were mixed Friday as investors assess what Jensen Huang’s resignation as Nvidia CEO means for the global artificial intelligence industry. futures edged higher despite earlier losses on Wall Street, which saw Nvidia falling more than 4% after Huang’s exit from the company.
